observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Canon DSLR camera body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 760D' visible on the top right. The camera is mounted on a black strap with red trim. A lens is visible in the background. The flash is attached and extended.

Photo 1: Front view of the same camera, slightly different angle. The 'Canon' and 'EOS 760D' text is clearly visible. The camera body appears clean with no visible damage. The strap is still attached.

Photo 2: Side view showing the camera body, strap, and two external flashes. The camera is placed on a white surface. The flashes are black and rectangular, with one having a hot shoe mount. The camera body is still attached to the strap. The background is plain white, suggesting a studio setup.

claims.claim: It is a great and affordable camera for the price
claims.evidence: Subjective claim about quality and value; cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.claim: it comes with a bag, microphone and a flash
claims.evidence: No bag, microphone, or flash is visible in any photo. The seller's text claims these are included, but none are shown.

risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens or accessories may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the lens and any included accessories (bag, microphone, flash) laid out together.

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden physical damage (scratches, dents, or internal wear)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the camera body, especially around the lens mount, buttons, and screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having minor cosmetic damage

Photo of the lens and any included accessories (bag, microphone, flash) laid out together.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
